promotion_tools.title: Engagement Tools
promotion_tools.body: Hold them for longer, with more turnover & profitable play sessions

items.title: Tournament Tools
items.body: Build tournaments and challenges around your players: the prize pool, the qualifying games, a weekend sprint, a month long leaderboard, every parameter is yours to move.

items.title: GGR Discount
items.body: A rebate on your revenue share. The more volume you push through our content, the less you pay on it. No minimum commitment, no upfront spend to recover.

items.title: Player Cashback
items.body: Return a share of player spend straight back into their balance. It stretches a deposit further, softens a losing session and gives players a reason to return tomorrow.

items.title: Mystery Jackpot
items.body: Opt into our jackpot network and pick the tiers that suit your audience. A headline pot worth millions, backed by daily and mini jackpots that land often enough to keep the chase real.

items.title: Free Rounds
items.body: Reward your best players with free rounds, and customised everything: a welcome gift, a reactivation nudge, a thank you to a top depositor. Conditions are set per campaign.

items.title: Prize Drops
items.body: Randomised prizes within your casino. Any spin can pay, which turns an ordinary session into one worth staying in. Set the prize table, the drop frequency and the game list.
